items.title: Net Zero
tags: Turn heads with this striking custom wrap inspired by pristine glaciers and the future of sustainability. Shades of icy turquoise and soft whites flow across the car’s contours, giving a dynamic frozen landscape effect that evokes clarity, freshness, and environmental consciousness. Accents of light green subtly highlight the Net Zero branding, emphasizing the drive toward zero emissions. Every curve of the Tesla Model Y comes alive under this design
